LanguageData.MST.earliestDayComment: The earliest number of days for which this event is triggered.
LanguageData.MST.minPopulationComment: The minimum population required to trigger this event. If the colony's population is less than the minimum population, the event will not be triggered.
LanguageData.MST.minGreatestPopulationComment: The maximum population required to trigger this event. The event will be triggered only if the population of the colony has ever exceeded the maximum population.
LanguageData.MST.minAnomalyThreatLevelComment: The required level of boulders for triggering this event.
LanguageData.MST.minThreatPointsComment: The minimum number of threat points for this event.
LanguageData.MST.maxThreatPointsComment: The maximum number of threat points for this event.
LanguageData.MST.baseChanceWithRoyaltyComment: The probability of this event being triggered if the DLC "Royal Power" is available.
LanguageData.MST.diseaseVictimFractionRangeComment: The fraction of colonists that can be infected by this disease (min-max range).
LanguageData.MST.actualChanceComment: The actual probability = baseChance / (sum of all baseChance in this category). Shows Null if baseChance is 0.
